law: LAWS 7 -- EVERY PRODUCER OWES CELLS. A producer that consumes compute and puts no cell in front of the judge inside its own window is a defect with an owner. It passes its fence only by DECLARING itself here: a BLOCKER (`why` of 20+ chars and an `owner`) says the production is broken and who owns the fix; an EXEMPTION (`exempt: true` with `produces` and `consumer`) says the organ makes something other than cells by design, names what it makes, and names who reads it. Silence is neither, and silence is what the fence fails on.
note: A blocker is a debt, not an excuse. Every row here is expected to disappear by being fixed, and the fence's owing ratchet falls only, so a row that stays becomes visible as a number that stopped falling. An EXEMPTION here is PERMANENT only while it stays true: every row carries `retire_if`, the condition that deletes it, so a declaration cannot outlive the fact it was declared on.
